title: Polynomial bound for the query cost
statement:
For natural numbers $l,L,N,c,e$ satisfying $N\le L$, one has
\[
2\bigl(2L+9+(l+5)(3L+7)+N\bigl(l(5L+7)+2L+7\bigr)\bigr)+c(N+1)^e+2\le (100(l+10)+c)(L+1)^{e+2}.
\]
replaced: For all naturals with $N \le L$, the complete query ledger, twice the scan cost $2L + 9 + (l+5)(3L+7) + N(l(5L+7) + 2L + 7)$ plus $c(N+1)^e + 2$, is at most $(100(l+10) + c)(L+1)^{e+2}$, one common monomial in the encoded argument length $L$.
